name: Cyclophosphamide
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 40 to 50 mg/kg in divided doses over 2 to 5 days; or 10 to 15 mg/kg every 7 to 10 days; or 3 to 5 mg/kg twice weekly

Glomerular disease regimens (lupus nephritis, ANCA vasculitis) use much lower IV doses than the oncology doses shown, with reductions for age and kidney function; follow the KDIGO 2024 lupus nephritis or ANCA-associated vasculitis guideline and a nephrologist.

key_interactions.effect: More cytotoxic metabolites: infection, neutropenia, mucositis (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other myelosuppressive, nephrotoxic, cardiotoxic or hepatotoxic drugs; radiation

pk.half_life_eskd: 6.5 hours in uremic patients; 3.3 hours during hemodialysis (label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 10% to 20% unchanged in urine; mostly metabolites
